title: Korean Hangul for Travel: Read Signs in an Hour
summary: Learn how Hangul syllable blocks work and sound out useful Korean travel words. Even a little practice can make signs and menus easier to read.

slides.title: Read Hangul In An Hour
slides.voice: Korean signs confusing? Sound out Hangul in an hour.

slides.title: One Syllable, One Block
slides.voice: Each syllable is one square: consonant, vowel, sometimes a final consonant.

slides.title: Seoul In Two Blocks
slides.voice: 서 is s plus eo; 울 is silent plus u plus l. Together, 서울 spells Seoul.

slides.title: Read Useful Signs
slides.voice: Read 지하철 as subway and 출구 as exit. Station signs often show English alongside Hangul, so check your reading.
